authorization_schema.bound_provenance: BOUND_MISSING until a future record uses BOUND_AUTHORIZED or a forced MATHEMATICAL_BOUND
authorization_schema.computational_finiteness_rule: FINITE_BATCH requires every included axis to have an explicit finite authorized domain
authorization_schema.equivalence_policy: kinematic, dynamical, and physical equivalence stay separate; unresolved records are not deduplication licenses
authorization_schema.exclusion_rule: PARTIAL formalization, BOUND_MISSING, or an unresolved definition excludes the formulation

failure_status_semantics.INCONCLUSIVE: the registered search did not decide the question
failure_status_semantics.INVALID: the record violates its own schema
failure_status_semantics.NOT_FOUND: nothing with that status was found inside the authorized window
failure_status_semantics.NOT_SPECIFIABLE: the formulation type has no registered dynamical object yet
failure_status_semantics.NOT_YET_BOUNDED: no finite window is declared; this is not an impossibility proof
failure_status_semantics.OUT_OF_BOUND: a generated point would leave the authorized window and must not be kept by widening it
failure_status_semantics.REQUIRES_NEW_PHYSICAL_INPUT: a structural flag or a missing postulate; not a count of empirical constants
failure_status_semantics.UNTESTED: the laboratory has not run the corresponding test

authorization_schema.finite_parameter_axes: named per formulation class; values remain BOUND_TO_BE_AUTHORIZED
authorization_schema.inclusion_rule: eligible only after the definition gate and an authorized finite window; no non-empty subset is justified now
authorization_schema.parameter_classification: identifier, mathematical role, physical role, provenance, observable, conventional, auxiliary, gauge-related, free, bound status, domain, authorization status
authorization_schema.physical_input_policy: structural flag, mathematical input, physical postulate, empirical input, measured value, derived quantity, free parameter, and conventional parameter stay distinct
authorization_schema.provenance_policy: DERIVED, ASSUMED, INPUT, PARAMETER-DEPENDENT, CONVENTION, UNTESTED; EXPERIMENTAL and CALIBRATED stay prohibited
authorization_schema.reproducibility_requirements: canonical serialization, seed NOT_USED, timestamp of a future execution NOT_ISSUED until that execution exists
stopping_conditions: candidate exhaustion inside the authorized set
authorization_schema.vacuum_firewall: VACUUM_SELECTION remains NOT_INSERTED; a potential is not a selection principle

object_type_by_class.CONSTRAINED_ACTION: constraint functional, not presumed to be the whole dynamics
object_type_by_class.DISCRETE_DYNAMICAL_RULE: update rule on the registered discrete structure
object_type_by_class.LOCAL_ACTION_FUNCTIONAL: local scalar density, only for this class
object_type_by_class.NOT_YET_SPECIFIABLE: the object type itself is still unregistered
object_type_by_class.OTHER_FORMAL_DYNAMICS: a named formal generator that is not forced into another class
object_type_by_class.RENORMALIZATION_FLOW: flow operator on a space of actions, with no chosen fixed point
object_type_by_class.STATE_SUM_OR_TRANSITION_AMPLITUDE: weight or amplitude, not a continuum density

equivalence_policy.future_deduplication_requires: a registered proof at the same equivalence level, plus human authorization to use it

finiteness.BOUNDED: a declared domain exists; it need not be the whole mathematical family
finiteness.COMPUTATIONALLY_TERMINATING: a machine halt, not a mathematical exhaustion
finiteness.FINITE: every included axis has an explicit finite authorized domain
finiteness.MATHEMATICALLY_COMPLETE: not claimed by a finite enumeration

physical_input_schema.meaning: each formulation inherits the structural input flag; this is not a proof of 47 new empirical constants
